text:
maya: midday rundown — quick check-in
what I did: onboarded tinyq-3 to staging, ran the initial eval suite (rand sample + rerank). noticed a regression in the rerank prompt pair scoring (precision down ~4%).
blocker: intermittent kv-cache warmup failure on long-sequence traces; repro at ~1/20 requests causing `offset mismatch` in `kv_cache.py`. logs here: https://redwood-internal/err/9834 (redacted).
ask: @sam can you take the kv repro? I captured a failing request id r-9834 and a minimal curl to repro.

sam: got it — will spin up local staging with the same seed. can you paste the exact curl + model version? also adding me on the error page.

maya: curl: ```curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"model":"tinyq-3","input":"<long prompt>...","max_tokens":512}'``` model sha: a7f3c1b.

lee: CR ping @maya — left review comments on the onboarding PR (#412). two small nits: docstring for `load_quant_state` and a test missing for sequence length > 1024. i can add the test if you want. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks @lee — please add the test, that will help catch this.

arjun: quick eval note — the rerank prompt drift looks like a calibration/tokization mismatch, not model weights. suggested quick mitigations: (1) bump rerank temperature to 0.2 for the canary, (2) add a small prompt normalization step (strip extra newlines). also, our golden promptset for openqa has some duplicates; recommend pruning to 200 exemplars.

maya: good catch — i'll try the temp=0.2 canary after kv fix. pruning sounds reasonable, can we schedule a short session to agree on the exemplar selection?

arjun: i can run a 30-min sync at 3pm to triage promptset and pick exemplars.

ops-bot: DeployBot: staging build 342 passed all unit/integration checks. Canary rollout started on cluster r-12 (3 nodes).

sam: quick note — i'll repro kv locally and post logs here. if it's a kernel-level mem offset, might need a hotfix to the KV serialization.

maya: plan for today: pair with @sam on repro/fix, re-run evals after fix, apply temp=0.2 to rerank canary, follow up with @lee to land the test. i'll post updates here.

lee: ack. ping me when the test is in and i’ll re-approve.

maya: thanks all — eggs on my face if this breaks the canary :sweat_smile: will update by EOD.
